content_metadata.description: A detailed look into sheep brain dissection focusing on different parts and their functions, presented by a professor.

qAndA.question: What is the well-formed circle in the middle of the brain called?
What does the pineal gland produce?
What percentage of males is the interthalamic adhesion missing in?
What connects the third and fourth ventricle?
What is the white matter within the gray matter of the cerebellum called?
